name: Nova Re SIIQ S.p.A.
summary: Nova Re SIIQ S.p.A. is an Italian real estate company operating as a Società di Investimento Immobiliare Quotata (SIIQ), which is similar to a REIT. The company invests in and manages a portfolio of properties, primarily in Italy. Nova Re SIIQ S.p.A. is headquartered in Italy.
